items.name: MECH
items.description: IDE for mechanistic interpretability - inspect neurons, attention heads, residual streams and SAE features, then trace how they causally compose into a prediction. Includes Logit/Tuned Lens, causal tracing, 60+ discovery modules and a reproducibility benchmark suite (IOI, induction heads, copy task).

items.name: nebula
items.description: Nebula is an interactive mechanistic interpretability suite for large language models. It provides real-time, layer-by-layer visual teardowns of transformer inference: tokenization, attention heads, KV cache lifecycle, Mixture of Experts routing, residual stream logit lens, neuron activation filtering, and counterfactual activation patching.
